-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

During the design of the station configuration table, it has been confirmed that the idempotency fingerprint must include the operator field. Specific detail fields to include for capacity errors have been confirmed, and parameter sanity checks will be split into two tiers: basic parameter validity will be verified at draft time with a 400 response, while full rule checks will be performed at publish time returning 422 or 429 as needed.

I’ve finalized the validation strategy for station stop times. Only non-null checks and same-operation-day containment checks will be performed at the draft write stage to align with existing occupancy rule logic, while more critical checks including arrival time precedes departure time, station existence and dwell time validity will be carried out at the publish stage to fully meet the specified error handling requirements.

I’ve confirmed that adjacent section slot conflicts and platform capacity checks will be performed in the same transaction during publish. Station stop chronology consistency with section occupancies is not required, and I will only implement a risk-free relevant consistency check.
